idea.research_question: Can Landsat and MODIS time series be combined to improve crop-yield or vegetation-productivity estimation across space and time?
idea.hypothesis: MODIS supplies dense temporal vegetation dynamics while Landsat supplies finer spatial structure; their fusion should improve both temporal continuity and spatial detail.
idea.mechanism: Temporal harmonization and spatial fusion construct vegetation trajectories, which are evaluated against yield or independent productivity observations and against single-sensor baselines.
idea.analytical_approach: Spatiotemporal image fusion, vegetation-index trajectory modelling and yield prediction
idea.expected_contribution: A reproducible benchmark for testing whether a proposed idea preserves all required data roles and adds auxiliary data only for a distinct mechanism, validation or refinement purpose.
idea.falsification_condition: The idea fails if it drops a required role, cannot align the required inputs, or does not improve explanatory, predictive or validation performance over the appropriate single-source baseline.
